name: Meta Controller
role: External final control authority evaluated before any decision.
responsibilities: Be evaluated before any system decision.
Provide final authority to allow, block, or override decisions.
Remain mandatory in the control path and cannot be bypassed.
controls: Decision authority ordering before downstream decision handling.
Final allow, block, or override authority over controlled decisions.
Non-bypassable control boundary referenced by CORE PRINCIPLES and do NOT override Meta Controller decisions.
does_not_do: Does not define dataset builder execution logic in this file.
Does not define storage routing in this file.
interfaces: Control decision output consumed before decision handling by Plenra Dataset Builder Service.

name: learning_dataset
role: Passive storage destination for approved learning records.
responsibilities: Receive only approved data routed for learning storage.
Store approved learning records without altering decision outcomes.
controls: Learning destination boundary referenced by ROUTING RULES, CRITICAL FIREWALL, and FINAL RULE.
interfaces: Inbound approved records from ROUTING RULES.

name: audit_log
responsibilities: Record all decisions, including blocked decisions.
Preserve auditability for blocked, duplicate, and non-learning flows.
controls: Audit destination boundary referenced by ROUTING RULES.
Auditability path referenced by CORE PRINCIPLES and FINAL RULE through immutable record retention.
interfaces: Inbound appended records from ROUTING RULES and duplicate/audit flows.
